_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Stress is present but price and F&G have not broken the range and fed liquidity still bids, so the consensus stays in the coil one rung either side of Complacency until a confirmed breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency low conviction; narrative silent on forward phase and only supplies flow narrowing color
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds the recent range and fear_greed stays 45-60 while dvol percentile rolls over from 94
next_move.invalidated_if: Range breakdown with etf_flows stuck near 0, funding flipping negative, and dvol staying above 90
